notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). StrategyWiki has a stub page (completion stage 0, marked a perfect stub); its Walkthrough, Gameplay and Table of Contents are linked but no subpages exist. splitfiction.fandom.com answers the API; its "Split Fiction" page has only 2 links ("Mio" and "Zoe"); names only were looked at, nothing copied. The Steam schema calls the app "Split"; the store list confirms app 2001120 (a separate "Friend's Pass" app, 3052150, was not used). There are only 20 Steam achievements, 3 hidden. Most descriptions are jokes that do not say where they unlock, so 14 sit in a catch-all Secrets and Gags chapter; the chapter split is thin and could be improved with original play notes.
